sam: Quick probe results from hybrid speculative + commitment-sampling run on llama3-70b-nf4-q. TL;DR: ~1.8x throughput, but we see tail-context quality regressions after ~1k tokens for open-ended code tasks.
priya: re: numbers — what's the eval set and metric?
sam: 1k prompts sampled from internal code-gen bench (mostly function-completion, n=800) + long-context summarization (n=200). Metrics: top-1 exact match for code, ROUGE-L for text, and avg logprob gap. Baseline = greedy prefetched decode; new = commit-sample (k=3 speculative, commit prob threshold 0.6).
alex: can you paste the config?
sam: ```json
{
  "model": "llama3-70b-nf4",
  "speculative_k": 3,
  "commit_threshold": 0.6,
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "batch": 32,
  "prefix_cache": true
}
```
lina: interesting. where is the quality drop happening?
sam: mostly after token 1k in summarization tasks; pass@1 for code drops ~2.5% absolute, ROUGE-L drops ~1.8 pts on long summaries. Short prompts unchanged.
maria: any hypothesis?
sam: two small ones: (1) commit-sample bias — sampling noise early accumulates into bad KV cache states, (2) nf4 quantization + speculative mismatch amplifies entropy underflows. We saw higher entropy variance in commit windows.
priya: did you try delayed commit (hold commit until stable n tokens)?
sam: yes. delaying commit by 8 tokens recovers ~60% of the regression but loses ~10% of speedup.
alex: any quick mitigation we can flip in prod?
sam: options: raise commit_threshold to 0.8 (safe, speed ~1.5x), enable dynamic temperature tapering toward 0 after 800 tokens, or use fallback to greedy for >1k contexts. I'd prefer threshold bump + dynamic temp.
lina: please add small reproducible test and perf/degradation curves in CI.
sam: filed a ticket: infra/1992 (placeholder). Will push a minimal A/B: 10% traffic, threshold 0.8, delayed-commit=0/8, collect EM/ROUGE and latency.
ci-bot: [ci] created job hybrid-spec-1992, queued.
maria: nice. also check KV cache eviction interplay — maybe cache tiling causes misalignment after speculative commits.
sam: noted — will run cache-tiling ablation next.
priya: thanks. please drop the raw CSVs in /shared/eng-ml/speculative/runs/1992 when ready.
sam: will do, aiming EOD.
